Frequently asked questions

Quick answers before you hit the trail.

How does the lifetime warranty work? ＋
If any product fails due to manufacturing defects or normal wear during your lifetime, we repair or replace it free of charge. Just start a return on our support page and include photos.
What's your return policy? ＋
Unused items can be returned within 30 days for a full refund. Used items can be returned within 30 days for store credit. Returns are free for members.
Do you ship internationally? ＋
We ship to 40+ countries. Duties are calculated at checkout, and orders over $150 ship free worldwide during our seasonal sales.
